findings.statement: Deltek Vantagepoint is at ~30% utilization despite being the most expensive system. Dela AI is free and nobody has turned it on.
findings.roadmap_implication: Activate Dela AI before buying new tools. Build Deltek MCP server for AI agent access to project data.

findings.statement: Panzura stores 50TB across 12 edge nodes but has zero search capability. People can't find files they know exist.
findings.roadmap_implication: File Share Connector for Copilot can index Panzura via SMB. Quick win that unlocks institutional knowledge.

findings.statement: ~40% of staff are already using ChatGPT with client data, without guidance or guardrails.
findings.roadmap_implication: AI security guidelines needed BEFORE the shareholder meeting. Board-level blocker if not addressed.

findings.statement: CRM (eway) has 50 licenses but only 2-3 active users. The firm tracks BD in Excel spreadsheets.
findings.roadmap_implication: CRM is a symptom of a broader data input problem. Don't add another tool; fix the input friction.

findings.statement: Institutional knowledge lives in individual people's heads, not in systems. Jason gets 5-10 requests/week because he IS the search engine for W/WW.
findings.roadmap_implication: Knowledge capture is urgent — key people retiring within 3-5 years. AI-powered knowledge base is a Tier 1 recommendation.

findings.statement: Copilot is deployed but most people got zero training. Usage is accidental discovery, not systematic adoption.
findings.roadmap_implication: Copilot 101/201 training program is the lowest-friction, highest-impact starting point.

themes.name: Tool Underutilization
themes.description: Multiple systems purchased but running at a fraction of their capability. The problem isn't the tools — it's activation and training.

themes.name: Data Accessibility
themes.description: Information exists but can't be found. Files on Panzura, knowledge in people's heads, project data locked in Deltek.

themes.name: Shadow AI
themes.description: Staff are already using AI tools on their own, without guidance. The firm needs to lead, not chase.

themes.name: Institutional Knowledge Risk
themes.description: Critical knowledge lives in individual people. Retirements and departures create knowledge loss the firm can't recover from.

quickWins.title: Activate Dela AI in Deltek
quickWins.description: Free AI assistant included with Vantagepoint license. Natural language querying of projects, contacts, activities. Nobody has turned it on.

quickWins.title: Copilot 101/201 Training Sessions
quickWins.description: Most staff have Copilot but got zero training. 2-3 sessions covering email drafting, meeting summaries, document generation.

quickWins.title: Panzura File Share Connector
quickWins.description: Graph Connector Agent indexes Panzura files via SMB for Copilot search. Supports DOC, PDF, PPT, XLS. Respects NTFS ACLs.
quickWins.who_benefits: All staff (solves 'can't find the file' problem)
quickWins.prerequisite: Confirm Copilot license tier with Tim. Install Graph Connector Agent on-premises.

quickWins.title: AI Usage Guidelines One-Pager
quickWins.description: Clear, practical guide: what you CAN share with AI (non-client, internal processes) vs. what needs enterprise tools (client data, financials).

quotes.text: I spend probably 5-10 hours a week answering questions that are in the files somewhere, people just can't find them.
I would imagine it's like adding a couple staff.

quotes.text: We don't want to cram AI down people's throats.
I've been using ChatGPT for two years. It's changed how I work entirely.
We have tools we don't even know we have.

contradictions.statement: Culture-first philosophy ('don't cram AI down people's throats') vs. 40% already using uncontrolled ChatGPT with client data
T&M billing model means efficiency gains reduce revenue, yet leadership wants AI to make people more productive
Desire for data-driven decisions vs. CRM with 2-3 active users out of 50 licenses
